title: Winter Wonder
description: This mod adds a new biome called "Winter Wonderland"
body:
"Winter Wonder"
This mod adds a new biome to your Minecraft world called "Winter Wonderland" you may be wondering what is IN the biome and i have a couple answers!
-Winter leaves
-Winter grass
-Twinkle flowers
-A Star
-Candy cane blocks
-A edible candy cane item
-And maybe some other things i dont know
